title: Preferred cloud chosen by evidence, not 'keys prefer'
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. With several keys and no explicit preference, pick and switch the preferred cloud from health and evidence; an explicit choice still wins. Tests zc_preferred_auto_*.
